[Integrated distance expansion] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0302 ↗ lem:chow-iii-changing-distance-expansion 1. ch24:24.23\group Heat Kernel Asymptotics

Along the radial geodesic $\gamma $, for $0<s\le r_\tau (x)$, \[ \int _0^s\partial _\tau r_\tau (\gamma (\bar s))\, d\bar s =\frac{s^2}{2r_\tau (x)^2}\mathcal R_{ij}(y,\tau )x_\tau ^ix_\tau ^j +O(s^3). \]
